pm_exper_user_2050_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some great community center activities to help you stay cool and have fun during scorching summer afternoons?
pm_exper_user_2050_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) If the pool has open swim hours in the afternoon, you could bring some diving rings or a beach ball and make up your own games in the shallow end, which is a great way to enjoy the water when it’s super hot outside.
(b) On extra hot days, you could spend the afternoon at the community pool, splashing around with friends or playing water games to stay cool. It’s a fun way to enjoy the sunshine without getting overheated.
(c) On extra hot days, you could spend the afternoon in the community center’s air-conditioned game room, playing board games or doing crafts with others. It’s a fun way to enjoy being around people without getting overheated.
(d) You might like joining a summer swim club at the community center, where you can practice swimming, try races, and even make new friends while keeping nice and cool in the water.
